summary: Adapt Library catalogue fields, production counters and recipe navigation to the selected host.
details: The generic catalogue receives an explicit host and imports no MIR state. Historical host reads never probe the missing research_trigger property; modern trigger research and shared hidden/prerequisite gates remain intact.

The modern host retains per-surface normal-quality rates. The game API host reads force-wide production and consumption using its native string-name and input-boolean query. The shared core rejects unknown or inconsistent scopes, and the existing panel labels force-wide observations as all surfaces.

Recipe navigation opens the current recipe in the modern native encyclopedia. Older hosts avoid the absent API and explain that their affected-recipe list is informational. Native technology-window navigation is preserved on both API families.

Strict controlled host objects and actual click/selection callbacks exercise both API shapes, missing recipes, compact/full recipe lists, foreign controls and separate player state. Historical Library remains disabled; native statistics, GUI, lifecycle, locale/event and complete host composition acceptance remain pending.

The retained standalone no-MIR runner refuses obsolete profile materialization before resolving inputs. Its scenario and the Tin explanation fixture consume the explicit host contract; their native acceptance remains separate.
